d: We are currently looking for dynamic and self-motivated Front Office professionals who are eager to advance their careers.
As a Front Desk Agent, you will be responsible for providing professional and guest-focused service, ensuring that every guest enjoys a memorable stay.
q: Ideally, a degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or a related field.
Previous experience in the Front Office department within a hotel.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; knowledge of an additional language is an advantage.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Computer literacy, with previous experience using Opera PMS considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate should be guest-focused, proactive, and enthusiastic, with an outgoing, charismatic, and approachable personality. The candidate must be able to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment and thrive as a team player while interacting with colleagues and guests from diverse cultural backgrounds.
r: Provide prompt, courteous, and efficient service to all guests, ensuring a high level of guest satisfaction through personalized service from arrival to departure.
Ensure guests are personally greeted by name, whenever possible, and escorted to their rooms to make them feel welcomed and valued.
Conduct in-room and hotel familiarization, assisting guests with inquiries and requests regarding hotel activities and services.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of hotel information and local services, including operating hours, promotions, events, attractions, and other relevant information to respond effectively to guest inquiries.
Maintain awareness of daily room rates and occupancy levels.
Accurately perform Front Desk cashiering duties in accordance with established systems, policies, and procedures.
Process guest accounts from check-in to check-out, ensuring accurate posting of all incidental charges using computerized Front Office systems.
Maintain guest privacy and confidentiality by ensuring that personal information is not disclosed to unauthorized individuals.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of hotel policies, procedures, and service standards, along with comprehensive knowledge of hotel facilities, services, and ongoing activities.

d: Job Category Rooms & Guest Services Operations
Location West Crescent, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai, United Arab EmiratesVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
